q1.explanationZh: a (an) 是不定冠词“一个”：辅音音素开头的词前用 a，元音音素开头的词前用 an。

q2.explanationZh: abandon 及物动词“放弃；抛弃”，派生词 abandoned“被遗弃的”。

q3.explanationZh: ability 名词“能力”，常用 have the ability to do sth.。

q4.explanationZh: able 形容词“能够……的”，常用 be able to do。

q5.explanationZh: ab- 表示“偏离”，abnormal“反常的”，反义词是 normal。

q6.explanationZh: aboard 既可作副词也可作介词，表示“在船（或飞机、车）上”。

q7.explanationZh: about 作介词“关于；在……周围”，作副词“在四周；到处”。

q8.explanationZh: above 表示“在……上方”，不一定是正上方；正上方用 over。

q9.explanationZh: abroad 是副词，go abroad“出国”，前面不加介词 to。

q10.explanationZh: absence 是 absent 的名词形式“缺席；缺乏”。

q11.explanationZh: absent 形容词“缺席的”，常用 be absent from。

q12.explanationZh: absolute 形容词“完全的；绝对的”，副词是 absolutely。

q13.explanationZh: absolute 加 -ly 构成副词 absolutely“完全地；绝对地”。

q14.explanationZh: absorb 及物动词“吸收；使全神贯注”，be absorbed in“专心于”。

q15.explanationZh: abstract 作形容词“抽象的”，作名词“摘要”。

q16.explanationZh: abuse 名词、动词同形，“滥用；虐待”，drug abuse“药物滥用”。

q17.explanationZh: academic 形容词“学术的；学业的”，名词 academy“学会；专科院校”。

q19.explanationZh: accept“（主动、愿意地）接受”，receive 只表示“收到”。

q20.explanationZh: access 名词“进入的机会；通道”，常用 have access to。

q22.explanationZh: accommodate 及物动词“提供住处；容纳”，注意双写 c 和 m。

q23.explanationZh: accommodate 的名词形式 accommodation“住处；膳宿”。

q24.explanationZh: accompany“陪伴；为……伴奏”，过去式 accompanied。

q25.explanationZh: accomplish 及物动词“完成；实现”，名词 accomplishment。

q26.explanationZh: accomplish 加 -ment 构成名词 accomplishment“成就”。

q27.explanationZh: according to“按照；根据”，to 是介词，后接名词。

q28.explanationZh: account 名词“账户；解释”，动词 account for“说明；占”。

q29.explanationZh: account 加 -ant 表示人，accountant“会计”。

q30.explanationZh: accurate“准确的”，名词 accuracy，反义词 inaccurate。

q31.explanationZh: accuse“指控”，常用 accuse sb. of sth.。

q32.explanationZh: accustom 及物动词“使习惯于”，accustom sb. to (doing) sth.。

q33.explanationZh: accustomed 形容词“习惯的”，be accustomed to (doing) sth.“习惯于”。

q34.explanationZh: ache 指持续的隐痛，可作不及物动词或名词，如 headache、toothache。

accept: have the ability to do sth.

q35.explanationZh: “有能力做某事”= have the ability to do sth.，ability 是名词。

q36.explanationZh: “能，会（做某事）”= be able to do，able 是形容词，前面要用 be。

q37.explanationZh: what about / how about“……怎么样”，about 后接名词或动名词。

q38.explanationZh: be about to do sth.“正要做某事”，表示即将发生的动作。

q39.explanationZh: “缺席”= be absent from，介词用 from。

q40.explanationZh: be absorbed in“被……所吸引；专心于”，介词用 in。

q41.explanationZh: by accident“偶然地”，相当于 by chance。

q42.explanationZh: “达到目的”= accomplish one’s aim/purpose/goal，三个名词任选一个。

q43.explanationZh: “创造奇迹”= accomplish wonders/miracles，wonders 和 miracles 都用复数。

q44.explanationZh: on account of = because of“因为”，后接名词或代词。

q45.explanationZh: on any account“无论如何”，一般用在否定句中。

q46.explanationZh: on no account“决不”，放在句首时句子要部分倒装。

q47.explanationZh: account for“说明，解释；占（百分比）”，没有被动语态。

q48.explanationZh: “指控某人……”= accuse sb. of (doing) sth.，介词用 of。

accept: be/get/become/grow accustomed to / be used to

q49.explanationZh: “习惯于”= be (get/become/grow) accustomed to = be used to，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

q50.explanationZh: 冠词 The 后需要名词，“由司机失职造成的”是事故，用单数 accident。

q51.explanationZh: is widely accepted“被广泛认可”，被动语态用过去分词 accepted。

q52.explanationZh: accuse sb. of sth.“指责某人……”，情态动词 can 后用动词原形。

q53.explanationZh: a slight American accent“一点美国口音”。

q54.explanationZh: the lack of ability to do sth.“缺乏做某事的能力”，ability 后接不定式。

q55.explanationZh: have access to“可以获取”，access 是不可数名词。

q56.explanationZh: be absorbed in“专心于”，so...that 结构中用 absorbed。

q57.explanationZh: take sth. into account“考虑到某事”。

q58.explanationZh: as has been stated above“如上所述”，above 作副词“在上面”。

q59.explanationZh: in order to 后接动词原形，accompany sb. through...“陪伴某人度过……”。

q60.sampleAnswer: Work hard, or you’ll accomplish nothing.
references: Work hard, or you’ll accomplish nothing.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “祈使句 + or + 将来时”表示“……，否则……”；“一事无成”= accomplish nothing。

q61.sampleAnswer: His lack of learning awareness accounts for his failure in the exam last week.
references: His lack of learning awareness accounts for his failure in the exam last week.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “是……的原因”可用 account for“说明，解释”；主语是第三人称单数，用 accounts。

q62.sampleAnswer: The relationship between parents can greatly affect their kid’s academic scores.
references: The relationship between parents can greatly affect their kid’s academic scores.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “学习成绩”= academic scores/performance；“影响”= affect。

q63.sampleAnswer: It is because the concept of “customer first” was carried out that this long-lost community shopping mall has been able to return to the public’s eyes.
references: It is because the concept of “customer first” was carried out that this long-lost community shopping mall has been able to return to the public’s eyes.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “正是因为……”用强调句 It is because... that...；“得以”用 be able to，现在完成时 has been able to。

q64.sampleAnswer: According to the data released, the housing prices in cities keep falling instead of rising.
references: According to the data released, the housing prices in cities keep falling instead of rising.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “根据”= according to；“一直下跌”= keep falling；“而非上涨”= instead of rising。

q65.sampleAnswer: She found it necessary to accustom her child to getting up early.
references: She found it necessary to accustom her child to getting up early.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “觉得有必要做某事”= find it necessary to do sth.；“使某人习惯于”= accustom sb. to doing sth.，to 是介词。

q66.sampleAnswer: The report about that family on TV has caused the concern of the society about the disadvantaged group.
references: The report about that family on TV has caused the concern of the society about the disadvantaged group.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “关于”= about；“弱势群体”= the disadvantaged group。

q67.sampleAnswer: English people are accustomed to driving on the left.
references: English people are accustomed to driving on the left.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: be accustomed to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词 driving；“靠左边”= on the left。

q68.sampleAnswer: They are so absorbed in the experiment that they are ignorant of what’s going on outside the lab.
references: They are so absorbed in the experiment that they are ignorant of what’s going on outside the lab.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “如此……以至于”= so...that...；“全神贯注于”= be absorbed in；“对……一无所知”= be ignorant of。

q69.sampleAnswer: After living abroad for many years, I finally returned home and realised that this was the place I had always longed for.
references: After living abroad for many years, I finally returned home and realised that this was the place I had always longed for.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “旅居海外”= live abroad，abroad 是副词，前面不加介词；“心心念念”可用 long for。
